scope: Synthetic local write kernels; compressed old-state correction is explicitly retained information.
precision_model: float64 work/metadata; weights stored at declared precision; bf16 emulated.
budget_policy: Sparse budget applies to correction data payload; report includes full patch metadata and full compressed NPZ receipt bytes.
comparison_policy: Snapshots and recovery receipts are both actually NPZ-compressed. Dense MEMIT covariance is included. No amortization is assumed.
memory_scope: Evaluator holds reference and temporary copies; disk-record size is not peak process memory.
hypothesis_scope: Numerical mechanism only: the v0.1 expected-entropy acquisition objective is unchanged.

scope.model: synthetic linear categorical classifier; not a pretrained LLM
scope.acquisition: expected unlabelled-probe entropy reduction under starting-model class probabilities
scope.claim: confidence-based acquisition proxy; no guaranteed causal or accuracy gain
scope.oracle: synthetic teacher supplies one real label only after each selected query
scope.reference_use: evaluator drift measurements and explicit checkpoint baseline; corrected protocols additionally access pre-edit state only when making the declared write-time patch
scope.roundoff_information: exact/sparse correction packets contain old-state information; correction application receives only predicted state and packet
scope.roundoff_budget: fraction of logical weight bytes bounds sparse correction payload only; serialized metadata overhead is separately counted
scope.record_accounting: base numeric arrays/scalars plus serialized correction packet; NPZ wrapper overhead excluded; totals are generated records, not peak memory
scope.memory_measurement: evaluator retains reference/per-trial copies; protocol payload counts are not measured process peak memory
scope.query_baseline_comparison: random/uncertainty share label budget and retained edit rule; compute is not matched
scope.bottom_rank_selection: fixed drop_rank=1; not tuned against original weights or heldout labels
scope.precision: initial and updated weights use requested precision; scoring uses float64 arithmetic
scope.candidate_order: forward/reverse evaluation of the same available candidates; class order fixed
